name: Ableton Push 3
source: Ableton's Push 2 manual (github.com/Ableton/push-interface), taken as Push 3's in controller mode; its USB product ID (0x1969) from community captures.
notes: Unverified: Ableton hasn't published Push 3's protocol. Lattice drives it as a Push 2 until a unit shows the differences (its MPE pads, the jog wheel and its new buttons wait for that). The port names are guessed from Push 2's.
